user.title: Connect manually to SceneGlow
user.description: SceneGlow devices are normally discovered automatically. Enter an address only when multicast discovery is unavailable.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On {name}, enable Home Assistant pairing and enter the six-digit PIN shown on the TV. SceneGlow will receive the compatible light catalogue grouped by Home Assistant Area.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate SceneGlow
reauth_confirm.description: Enable pairing on the TV and enter the new short-lived code.

reconfigure.title: Update SceneGlow connection
reconfigure.description: The stored server identity and installation UUID must match at the new address.

error.identity_mismatch: The SceneGlow server identity does not match
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid hostname or IP address
error.invalid_pairing_code: The PIN was rejected, expired, or pairing is not active on the TV
error.protocol_incompatible: This SceneGlow protocol version is not supported

abort.already_configured: This SceneGlow installation is already configured
abort.identity_mismatch: The discovered installation identity did not match its advertisement
abort.insecure_discovery: SceneGlow advertised an insecure non-local endpoint
abort.invalid_discovery: The SceneGlow discovery record is incomplete
abort.protocol_incompatible: This SceneGlow protocol version is not supported

service_control_failed.message: SceneGlow did not accept the capture request

revision_conflict.message: SceneGlow changed this configuration at the same time. Please try again.

fixture_control_failed.message: SceneGlow did not accept the fixture control request

configuration_control_failed.message: SceneGlow did not accept the configuration control request

control_unavailable.message: This SceneGlow control is unavailable on this device

invalid_configuration.message: SceneGlow rejected the change because it would create an invalid configuration
